nodes.summary: With a constant stratification term `N a`, the attenuation ratio of the exact intercept `1 - h² + N a` and the mean expected statistic is `(N a - h²) / (N h² ℓ̄ / M + N a - h²)`.
nodes.title: Attenuation ratio under constant stratification

nodes.summary: The attenuation ratio `(intercept - 1) / (mean χ² - 1)` of Loh et al. (2018).
nodes.title: Attenuation ratio

nodes.summary: The `N`-normalized score of marker `j` under stratification, `X_jᵀ y / N`.
nodes.title: Normalized score under stratification

nodes.summary: The `N`-normalized score `β̂ j = X_jᵀ y / N` of marker `j`. For a standardized column (`∑ i, X i j ^ 2 = N`) it is the marginal least-squares estimate of the effect of marker `j`; in general that estimate has denominator `∑ i, X i j ^ 2` instead of `N`.
nodes.title: Normalized marginal score in the LD-score model

nodes.summary: The association statistic `N * β̂ j ^ 2` under stratification.
nodes.title: Association statistic under stratification

nodes.summary: The association statistic `χ² j = N * β̂ j ^ 2` of marker `j`.
nodes.title: Association statistic in the LD-score model

nodes.summary: The confounding share `N a / (N a + N h² ℓ̄ / M)` lies in `[0, 1]` when `a`, `h²` and `ℓ̄` are nonnegative (as they are in the model: `a` is a square, `h² ≥ 0` by `Model.h2_nonneg`, LD scores are sums of squares).
nodes.title: Confounding share lies between 0 and 1

nodes.summary: With a constant stratification term `N a`, the share of the mean inflation above the exact null level `1 - h²` that is due to stratification is `N a / (N a + N h² ℓ̄ / M)`.
nodes.title: Confounding share of inflation under constant stratification

nodes.summary: The heritability is at most `1` when there is at least one individual.
nodes.title: Heritability is at most one in the LD-score model

nodes.summary: The heritability is nonnegative when there is at least one marker.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of heritability in the LD-score model

nodes.summary: LD-score regression (Bulik-Sullivan et al. 2015): for a standardized genotype matrix (`IsStandardized`, so that `ldCorr` is the sample correlation and `ldScore` the LD score) and `N ≠ 0`, `𝔼[χ² j] = N h² / M * ℓ j + (1 - h²)`. The expected association statistic is affine in the LD score, with slope `N h² / M` and intercept `1 - h²`. The proof uses only that column `j` has sum of squares `N`; the rest of the…
nodes.title: LD-score regression

nodes.summary: With a constant stratification term (`s² (X_jᵀ c / N)² = a` for every marker), the expected statistic is exactly affine in the LD score, with slope `N h² / M` and intercept `1 - h² + N a`.
nodes.title: LD-score regression with constant stratification

nodes.summary: Stratification inflation for a standardized genotype matrix and `N ≠ 0`: `𝔼[χ² j] = N h² / M * ℓ j + (1 - h²) + N s² (X_jᵀ c / N)²`.
nodes.title: Expected statistic under stratification for standardized genotypes

nodes.summary: Stratification inflation: for a probability measure and mean-zero effects and noise, `𝔼[χ² j] = N h² / M * ℓ j + (1 - h²) (∑ i, X i j ^ 2) / N + N s² (X_jᵀ c / N)²`.
nodes.title: Expected association statistic under stratification

nodes.summary: The exact expectation of the association statistic built from the `N`-normalized score, for an arbitrary genotype matrix: `𝔼[χ² j] = N h² / M * ℓ j + (1 - h²) * (∑ i, X i j ^ 2) / N`. (For `N = 0` both sides are `0` by the convention `x / 0 = 0`.)
nodes.title: Expected association statistic for an arbitrary genotype matrix

nodes.summary: The genotype matrix is standardized: every marker column has mean `0` and sum of squares `N` (unit sample variance).
nodes.title: Standardized genotype matrix

nodes.summary: For a standardized matrix each marker has correlation `1` with itself.
nodes.title: A standardized marker has correlation one with itself

nodes.summary: For a standardized matrix the correlations lie in `[-1, 1]` (Cauchy–Schwarz).
nodes.title: Correlations of standardized markers lie in (-1, 1)

nodes.summary: The normalized cross product `r j k = X_jᵀ X_k / N` of markers `j` and `k`. For a standardized genotype matrix (`IsStandardized`) it is the sample correlation of the two markers; for other matrices it is only a scale-dependent dot product.
nodes.title: Normalized cross product of genotype markers

nodes.summary: The LD score `ℓ j = ∑ k, r j k ^ 2` of marker `j` (an LD score in the sense of the cited paper for a standardized genotype matrix).
nodes.title: LD score of a marker

nodes.summary: With a constant stratification term `N a`, the mean expected statistic is `N h² ℓ̄ / M + (1 - h² + N a)`.
nodes.title: Mean association statistic with constant stratification

nodes.summary: Polygenic inflation: for a standardized genotype matrix with `N, M ≠ 0`, the mean expected association statistic is `1 - h² + N h² ℓ̄ / M`.
nodes.title: Polygenic inflation of the mean association statistic

nodes.summary: The mean LD score `ℓ̄ = (1 / M) ∑ j, ℓ j`.
nodes.title: Mean LD score

nodes.summary: The random-effects model of LD-score regression (Bulik-Sullivan et al. 2015), stated at the level of raw second moments, for `N` individuals and `M` markers with heritability `h2`.
nodes.title: Random-effects model of LD-score regression

nodes.summary: The phenotype with a stratification shift: `y i = (X β) i + ε i + s * c i`.
nodes.title: Phenotype with population stratification

nodes.summary: The phenotype `y = X β + ε`.
nodes.title: Phenotype in the LD-score model

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
